source_rule.activation: Approaching within 100 feet of, or traversing, an intersection or railroad grade crossing on a highway that is not one-way.
source_rule.obligation: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway during the activated interval.
source_rule.exception: Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.
source_rule.boundary: 100 feet is measured to the relevant intersection or railroad grade crossing boundary; requested lane-change stations cannot establish the observed distance.

needed_evidence: ego body footprint and time joined to the boundary
observed first left-side body contact and continuous distance during approach
proof that the vehicle was driven rather than stationary
ego body footprint and motion through the intersection
left-side occupancy over the traversal interval
authored and Native realized grade-crossing boundary
ego body motion, footprint, and distance
original highway direction and lane topology

current_draft_gap: The two generic case definitions vary a requested left-side entry distance but do not resolve the parking maneuver against actual driven left-side motion, the intersection versus grade-crossing alternatives, or the one-way exception. No case is selected.
